ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 90% of the fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the lateral tips and specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region covering the majority of both lobes; distinct high-intensity circular blob at mid-left lobe; dense high-intensity clusters on both far-lateral tips; multiple vertical linear white clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees, showing sharp convergence toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude serrations localized on the outer lateral margins; transition to smoother, low-frequency undulations as the contour approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the lower trailing edge of both lobes, curving upward to meet jagged, high-contrast distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast pixel clusters on the extreme left and right lobe tips, exhibiting irregular, roughly circular geometries consistent with distal barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, high-intensity vertical lines (rake marks) located on the lower-right lobe; additional isolated horizontal linear disruptions visible in the central-left region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on the right lobe; heavy scarring and possible minor tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, highly prominent high-intensity circular spot located in the medial region of the left lobe.
